- # A Plan to Revitalize New York State's Capital City








Governor Kathy Hochul has unveiled the Downtown Albany Strategy, a comprehensive, community-informed revitalization plan – part of the $400 million Championing Albany’s Potential Initiative and backed by $200 million in public investments from NYS.


[Learn more](https://esd.ny.gov/esd-media-center/press-releases/governor-hochul-unveils-downtown-albany-strategy-guide-200-million)

- # From Promise to Progress: Micron's Groundbreaking in CNY








Governor Hochul celebrated the groundbreaking of Micron’s semiconductor manufacturing facility in Clay, Onondaga County. The transformative $100+ billion investment cements Central New York as a global leader in advanced manufacturing.


[Learn more](https://esd.ny.gov/esd-media-center/press-releases/promise-progress-governor-hochul-celebrates-groundbreaking-microns)

- # Tariff Resource Guide








Visit ESD's resource page for information about tariffs and tools that may help reduce possible impact – and programs to help NYS businesses enter the global marketplace.


[Learn more](https://esd.ny.gov/tariff-resource-guide)

- # Historic Achievements for New York’s MWBE Program








Governor Kathy Hochul has announced New York delivered a record $3.3 billion in State spending with MWBE firms — and for the fifth consecutive year, has exceeded its MWBE utilization goal: a nation-leading 31.86%.


[Learn more](https://esd.ny.gov/esd-media-center/press-releases/governor-hochul-announces-record-setting-33-billion-state-spending)
